units.source_text: 是日也，天朗气清，景色宜人。

en.t: On that day, the sky was bright and the air was clear, and the scenery was delightful.
All kinds of birds sang in rivalry, their lovely voices pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 自亲王、公卿以至擅长诗道诸人，尽皆出席，探韵[\[2\]](#part1337.html#m2)赋诗。

en.t: From princes and court nobles to all those skilled in the art of poetry, everyone was present, drawing rhyme words and composing poems.

units.source_text: 源氏宰相探取一韵，报道：“臣谨探得‘春’字韵！”

en.t: Genji, the Counselor, drew one rhyme and announced, "Your servant has respectfully drawn the rhyme word 'spring'!"
His voice was clear and resonant, utterly unlike any ordinary sound.

units.source_text: 其次轮到头中将，众人对他也另眼看待。

en.t: Next came To no Chujo's turn, and everyone regarded him as someone exceptional as well.

units.source_text: 态度从容不迫，落落大方。

en.t: His manner was calm and unhurried, open, graceful, and self-possessed.

units.source_text: 报韵声调亦恭谨郑重，与众不同。

en.t: The tone in which he announced his rhyme was also respectful and solemn, setting him apart from the rest.

units.source_text: 其余诸人，尽皆相形见绌，畏缩不前。

en.t: All the others seemed inferior by comparison and shrank back, afraid to step forward.

units.source_text: 此外不能上殿的阶下诸文人，因见皇上及皇太子皆才华卓越，又值文运昌隆、人才辈出之秋，大家自惭形秽。

en.t: Meanwhile, the lesser scholars who were not permitted to ascend the hall saw that both the Emperor and the Crown Prince were extraordinarily talented, and that this was an age when letters flourished and gifted men appeared in abundance, so they all felt ashamed of their own inadequacy.

units.source_text: 在此光天化日之下、大庭广众之中举步上前探韵，虽然作诗之事并不困难，却感畏惧恐缩，手足无措。

en.t: To step forward in broad daylight before such a large assembly and draw a rhyme, though composing the poem itself was not difficult, filled them with fear and hesitation until they hardly knew what to do with themselves.

units.source_text: 反之，几个年老的文章博士，服装异常寒酸，却因惯于此事，态度从容自若。

en.t: By contrast, several elderly doctors of letters, though dressed in remarkably shabby clothing, were accustomed to such occasions and carried themselves with perfect composure.

units.source_text: 皇上观此种种情状，颇感兴趣。

en.t: The Emperor watched all these various scenes with considerable interest.
